InventoryItem.title: InventoryItem
InventoryItem.description: An individual inventory SKU/variant with micro-OCR embossed text, surface relief design details, quantity, low-stock threshold, optional compressed thumbnail, and perceptual visual fingerprint.

extractedText.description: Embossed, debossed, stamped, or printed text extracted via micro-OCR (0-200 chars).

designDetails.description: Physical finish, relief, and visual motif description (0-300 chars).

thumbnailBase64.description: Optional compressed JPEG thumbnail encoded in Base64 (<= 180000 chars).

fpHash.description: Optional 256-bit perceptual luminance hash for local visual similarity matching.

fpAvgRgb.description: Optional 3-element integer array [R, G, B] of average image color.

fpRadial.description: Optional 3-element integer array [center, ring, outer] radial luminance profile.

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Last modification timestamp; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

StockHistoryEntry.title: StockHistoryEntry
StockHistoryEntry.description: Immutable audit log entry recording a Stock IN or Stock OUT transaction.

itemId.description: Document ID of the associated InventoryItem.

itemName.description: Display label of the item at transaction time (1-200 chars).

thumbnailBase64.description: Optional compressed JPEG thumbnail encoded in Base64 (<= 180000 chars).

offlineQueued.description: Whether the transaction was originally queued while offline.

createdAt.description: Transaction timestamp; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/inventory/{itemId}.description: Private user-isolated inventory SKUs and variants.

/users/{userId}/history/{entryId}.description: Private user-isolated immutable Stock IN/OUT audit logbook.
